value.rationale: The motivating numerical integrator is designed for randomized low-dimensional least-squares dynamics. These quantities sharpen generic error upper bounds, set a reproducible minimal benchmark and distinguish sample-path conservation risk from mean convergence. The exact effect is not a routine numerical substitution or arbitrary parameter slice.
